title: Ogho
text: 2. Cattāro me bhikkhave oghā || katame cattāro || || Kāmogho bhavogho diṭṭhogho avijjogho || || ime kho bhikkhave cattāro oghā || || Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave catunnam oghānam abhiññāya pariññaya parikkhayāya pahānāya || la || ayam ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo ti || || 3--33. Yathā esanā evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ || ||
